comment: Clean redrawn schematic of the Shin-ei/Unicord Univibe model 905 (circa 1968), no designators; four LDR phase stages, phase-shift LFO with a lamp driver and a 115VAC supply (transformer skipped).
uncertain: unlabelled resistor in the lamp driver emitter: no value drawn
220uF supply caps: drawn '220' with polarity marks
50k: could be a trimmer rather than a panel pot
rows: phase stages: three base-bias from B+, four base to ground
phase stages: collectors, emitters and LDR series
output mix: series and to ground
LFO: base to ground, two in phase-shift network, emitter
lamp driver emitter below the 1k trim; value not drawn
preamp: B+ filter, input coupling, emitter bypass, output to phase stages and to output
phase stages coupling and output, electrolytic
LFO clamp; no part number given
supply rectifier; no part number given
CdS module: four LDRs and an incandescent lamp
intensity/depth to the lamp driver, unnamed
stops the LFO; drawn as a pushbutton contact
